title: cystopteris fragilis subsp. eufragilis
intro: Cystopteris fragilis subsp. eufragilis, commonly known as the fragile fern, is a subspecies of fern that belongs to the family Cystopteridaceae. It is native to Europe and has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The fragile fern's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The health benefits of Cystopteris fragilis subsp. eufragilis may also include its potential to reduce fever, alleviate coughs, and soothe digestive issues.
